s: to clank, clash, clatter, rattle (make the sound of hard objects, e.g. metal or glass, striking each other loudly and/or repeatedly)
there to be a (car) accident, usually without harm to life and limb
Fahr mal eben was langsamer, da vorne hat’s gescheppert.
Better drive a little slower right now, there’s been an accident over there.
to hit someone, to slap someone
